grid.layout_notes: 5×3; xWays expands heights 2–4; xSplit doubles symbols left on row.

win_system.notes: xWays + xSplit expand ways. Base ways not printed.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: xWays reveals 2–4 of same symbol (all xWays same kind). xSplit Wild splits all symbols to the left on the same row.

other.name: Super Scatter
other.how_it_works: Upgraded scatter; if FS triggered by Super Scatters, all symbols incl. scatter below Super Scatter convert to xWays on feature entry.

wilds.name: xSplit Wild
wilds.behavior: Splits all symbols to the left on the same row.

scatters.name: Scatter / Super Scatter
scatters.behavior: 3 Scatters → 7 Bunker Raid Spins; 4 → 10. May upgrade to Super Scatter (converts symbols below to xWays on entry).

specials.name: xWays
specials.behavior: Reveals 2–4 same symbol; all xWays show same kind. Sticky at bottom during Bunker Raid; collecting levels 1→3 removing low pays; each extra xWays +1 spin.

base_game_loop.summary: 5×3 ways spin with xWays (2–4 high, synced) and xSplit Wilds splitting leftward. 3/4 Scatters (or Super Scatters) start Bunker Raid 7/10 with sticky bottom xWays and level-ups that remove low pays. Buy 95–777× across 3 features.

phases.name: Spin
phases.what_happens: Reveal xWays; apply xSplit left-row splits.

phases.name: Bonus
phases.what_happens: 3/4 scatters → Bunker Raid 7/10; Super Scatter entry converts below symbols to xWays.

modes.name: Bunker Raid Spins
modes.trigger: 3 Scatters (7 spins) or 4 Scatters (10 spins). Super Scatter trigger converts symbols below Super Scatter to xWays on entry.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: All xWays sticky, stored at bottom of reels for feature.
modes.progressive_state: Collect xWays to level up Bunker Raid 1→3; each level removes more low paying symbols.

phases.name: Enter
phases.what_happens: Award 7 or 10; if Super Scatter entry, convert below symbols to xWays; stick xWays at bottoms.

phases.name: Level up
phases.what_happens: Collect xWays to advance levels 1–3 (low pays removed); +1 spin per extra xWays.

modes.effects: Sticky bottom xWays FS with 3 collect levels and +1 spin per xWays.

features.name: xSplit Wilds
features.effects: Split all symbols left on same row.

features.name: xWays
features.effects: 2–4 same symbol; all xWays same kind.

options.name: Nolimit Bonus — 3 features
options.effects: Buy one of three bonus features.

numeric_limits.hit_frequency_notes: Hit frequency 21.54%; free spins ~1 in 307; win 100× 1 in 840.

## xSplit Wilds
Not an ordinary wilds, and super potent as it’ll split all symbols to the left on the same row. Boom!

## xWays
Just as previously seen in a slot by Nolimit City - it’ll reveal 2-4 of the same symbol and all xWays symbols will reveal the same symbol for a major punch in the gut.

## Scatter symbols
Triggers the Bunker Raid Spins, but can also be upgraded to a Super Scatter symbol.

## Bunker Raid Spins
All xWays symbols will be sticky for the remainder of the feature, and always stored in the bottom of the reels. If the FS is triggered by Super Scatters, then all symbols, incl. the scatter, below the Super Scatter automatically converts to xWays symbols when entering the feature.\nCollect xWays symbols to level up the Bunker Raids Spin from level 1 to level 3 - each level with its upgrade of low paying symbols being removed.\nAwards 7 or 10 free spins if triggered by 3 or 4 scatters. Any additional xWays symbols award +1 spin retrigger.

## Nolimit Bonus - Feature Buy Functionality
Buy your way straight into one of the 3 different bonus features, ranging from 95x to 777x the base bet.
